L31·N5540unmasked layer
Not a clean lexical detector: it peaks on ordinary mid-sentence "pivot" tokens — auxiliaries/verbs, determiners, prepositions and the colon in a clock time — that sit right before the predicate or complement of a clause (with equally ordinary function words like "are/after/the/in" driving it strongly negative), so it looks like a syntactic-position/next-token-prediction unit rather than a semantic one.
